subtitle.en: From acceptance to your first day
subtitle.zu: Kusukela ekwamukelweni kuya osukwini lwakho lokuqala

blurb.en: Your first night away, registration surprises, O-Week and finding your feet. About 5 minutes.
blurb.zu: Ubusuku bakho bokuqala ungekho ekhaya, izimanga zokubhalisa, i-O-Week nokuzinza. Cishe imizuzu emi-5.

text.en: Some years, res accepts more students than it has beds. Imagine you arrive and there's no room for you. Outside, people offer rooms: "for students, pay the R1 500 deposit today".
text.zu: Eminye iminyaka, i-res yamukela abafundi abaningi kunemibhede enayo. Cabanga ufika kungekho kamelo lakho. Ngaphandle, abantu banikeza amakamelo: "abafundi, khokhani idiphozithi engu-R1 500 namuhla".

outcome.en: You hand over the R1 500 deposit. The "landlord" stops answering: it was a scam, it happens every year, and it's not your fault.
outcome.zu: Unikeza idiphozithi engu-R1 500. "Umnikazi wendlu" uyeka ukuphendula: bekungumkhonyovu, kwenzeka minyaka yonke, futhi akulona iphutha lakho.

tip.en: A real landlord lets you view the room and gives you a lease. Check the university's accredited list before paying anyone.
tip.zu: Umnikazi wangempela uyakuvumela ubone ikamelo futhi akunike isivumelwano. Hlola uhlu olugunyaziwe lwenyuvesi ngaphambi kokukhokhela noma ubani.

outcome.en: You hand over every rand you have and borrow {borrowed} from a friend to make up the R1 500. The "landlord" stops answering: it was a scam, it happens every year, and it's not your fault.
outcome.zu: Unikeza yonke imali onayo bese uboleka u-{borrowed} kumngane ukuze kuphelele u-R1 500. "Umnikazi wendlu" uyeka ukuphendula: bekungumkhonyovu, kwenzeka minyaka yonke, futhi akulona iphutha lakho.

outcome.en: The address doesn't match the photos. You walk away and keep looking on the university's accredited list.
outcome.zu: Ikheli alihambisani nezithombe. Uyahamba bese uqhubeka ufuna ohlwini lwenyuvesi olugunyaziwe.

outcome.en: The housing office finds you a temporary place and keeps you on the list. A room opens up in week two.
outcome.zu: Ihhovisi lezindawo zokuhlala likutholela indawo yesikhashana futhi likugcine ohlwini. Ikamelo liyavuleka ngesonto lesibili.

text.en: Your family has just left. The room is quiet, your phone is on 8%, and orientation starts tomorrow.
text.zu: Umndeni wakho usanda kuhamba. Ikamelo lithule, ifoni yakho isele no-8%, futhi ukwethulwa kuqala kusasa.

outcome.en: Hearing familiar voices helps. Someone at home says the house already feels empty without you.
outcome.zu: Ukuzwa amazwi ajwayelekile kuyasiza. Othile wasekhaya uthi indlu isivele ingenalutho ngaphandle kwakho.

outcome.en: You find the library, the dining hall and a shortcut to your first lecture. Tomorrow already feels less scary.
outcome.zu: Uthola umtapo wolwazi, ihholo lokudlela nendlela emfushane eya esifundweni sakho sokuqala. Kusasa sekuzwakala kungesabisi kangako.

outcome.en: You scroll until 2am. Feeling low on the first night is normal, and it usually lifts once you meet people.
outcome.zu: Uskrola kuze kube ngu-2 ekuseni. Ukuzizwa uphansi ngobusuku bokuqala kuvamile, futhi kuvame ukudlula uma usuhlangana nabantu.

text.en: This time there was no overbooking: your room was ready. Your family has just left, the room is quiet, your phone is on 8%, and orientation starts tomorrow.
text.zu: Kulokhu kwakungekho ukugcwala ngokweqile: ikamelo lakho lalilungile. Umndeni wakho usanda kuhamba, ikamelo lithule, ifoni yakho isele no-8%, futhi ukwethulwa kuqala kusasa.

text.en: It's 5:30am. Two taxis and a long walk stand between home and campus, and orientation starts at 8.
text.zu: Ngu-5:30 ekuseni. Amatekisi amabili nohambo olude ngezinyawo kuphakathi kwekhaya nekhampasi, futhi ukwethulwa kuqala ngo-8.

outcome.en: The second taxi takes forty minutes to fill. You walk in at 8:40, flustered.
outcome.zu: Itekisi lesibili lithatha imizuzu engamashumi amane ukugcwala. Ungena ngo-8:40, uphazamisekile.

outcome.en: You arrive at 7:30 with time to find the venue. Now you know how long the trip really takes.
outcome.zu: Ufika ngo-7:30 unesikhathi sokuthola indawo. Manje uyazi ukuthi uhambo luthatha isikhathi esingakanani ngempela.

outcome.en: A second-year from your street shows you the faster rank and which taxi to avoid. You travel in together.
outcome.zu: Umfundi wonyaka wesibili wasemgwaqweni wakho ukukhombisa irenki esheshayo nokuthi yiliphi itekisi okufanele ulibalekele. Nihamba ndawonye.

tip.en: Ask Student Affairs about commuter or day-student groups. Many campuses have a WhatsApp group for each route, for lifts and safe travel.
tip.zu: Buza kuMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi ngamaqembu abafundi abagibelayo. Amakhampasi amaningi aneqembu le-WhatsApp lomzila ngamunye, lokugibelisana nokuhamba ngokuphepha.

text.en: Registration, your timetable and the student portal are all online, and assignments must be typed. Your phone keeps logging you out.
text.zu: Ukubhalisa, uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo nephothali yabafundi konke kuku-inthanethi, futhi imisebenzi kufanele ithayiphwe. Ifoni yakho ihlala ikukhipha.

outcome.en: Your neighbour lets you use theirs for an hour. It works, but you can't do this every week.
outcome.zu: Umakhelwane wakho ukuvumela usebenzise eyakhe ihora elilodwa. Kuyasebenza, kodwa awukwazi ukwenza lokhu masonto onke.

tip.en: Borrowing works once. For every week, ask the library or IT help desk which computer labs are open late.
tip.zu: Ukuboleka kusebenza kanye. Okwamasonto onke, buza emtapweni noma edeskini le-IT ukuthi yimaphi amagumbi amakhompyutha avula kuze kube sebusuku.

outcome.en: You find a lab that's open late and save its hours in your phone.
outcome.zu: Uthola igumbi elivulekile kuze kube sebusuku futhi ulondoloze amahora alo efonini yakho.

outcome.en: Student Affairs shows you how to apply for a laptop loan, and which computer labs to use until yours is ready.
outcome.zu: UMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi ukukhombisa ukuthi ufaka kanjani isicelo sokubolekwa i-laptop, nokuthi yimaphi amagumbi amakhompyutha ozowasebenzisa kuze kube yilapho eyakho isilungile.

tip.en: Many universities lend laptops to students who need one, and some bursaries include money for study materials. Ask in your first week: loan laptops run out.
tip.zu: Amanyuvesi amaningi aboleka abafundi abayidingayo ama-laptop, futhi eminye imixhaso ifaka imali yezinto zokufunda. Buza ngesonto lakho lokuqala: ama-laptop okubolekwa ayaphela.

text.en: The registration system says you owe R1 000 upfront, or your funding hasn't been confirmed yet. You have {money}, and the queue behind you is getting longer.
text.zu: Uhlelo lokubhalisa luthi ukweleta u-R1 000 kuqala, noma uxhaso lwakho alukaqinisekiswa. Uno-{money}, futhi ulayini ngemuva kwakho uya ngokuya ude.

outcome.en: A relative lends you the money. You're registered, and you owe R1 000.
outcome.zu: Isihlobo sikuboleka imali. Usubhalisile, futhi ukweleta u-R1 000.

outcome.en: Your family scrapes it together. It's a real stretch for them, and you feel it.
outcome.zu: Umndeni wakho uyayiqoqa. Kuyabanzima ngempela, futhi uyakuzwa lokho.

outcome.en: You pay from the money you brought. You're registered, with very little left for the first weeks.
outcome.zu: Ukhokha ngemali oze nayo. Usubhalisile, kodwa kusele okuncane kakhulu emasontweni okuqala.

outcome.en: The office explains your options: some students can register while funding is confirmed, others set up a payment arrangement. You leave registered, without new debt.
outcome.zu: Ihhovisi likuchazela izindlela zakho: abanye abafundi bangabhalisa ngenkathi uxhaso luqinisekiswa, abanye benza isivumelwano sokukhokha. Uhamba usubhalisile, ngaphandle kwesikweletu esisha.

title.en: A first friend, from the registration queue

text.en: Two hours in the same queue and you've swapped numbers, music and survival tips. Your first friend.
text.zu: Amahora amabili emgqeni ofanayo futhi senishintshene ngezinombolo, umculo namathiphu okusinda. Umngane wakho wokuqala.

text.en: On your first day, the campus is a maze of buildings that all look the same. Your first session starts in ten minutes, and you can't find the venue.
text.zu: Ngosuku lwakho lokuqala, ikhampasi iyisixakaxaka sezakhiwo ezibukeka ziyefana. Iseshini yakho yokuqala iqala emizuzwini eyishumi, futhi awulitholi igumbi.

outcome.en: You arrive late and sweaty, but you get there. Next time you'll leave earlier.
outcome.zu: Ufika sekwephuzile ujuluke, kodwa uyafika. Ngokuzayo uzohamba kusenesikhathi.

outcome.en: A third-year walks you to the venue and tells you which taxis go to town. You save their number.
outcome.zu: Umfundi wonyaka wesithathu ukuhambisa egumbini futhi akutshele ukuthi yimaphi amatekisi aya edolobheni. Ulondoloza inombolo yakhe.

tip.en: Orientation leaders, mentors and house committee members wear name tags in the first weeks. They expect questions.
tip.zu: Abaholi bokwethulwa, abeluleki namalungu ekomidi lendlu bafaka amagama abo emasontweni okuqala. Balindele imibuzo.

outcome.en: The tour shows you lecture halls, the library, the clinic and where to get help. You meet two other first-years.
outcome.zu: Uhambo lukukhombisa amahholo ezifundo, umtapo wolwazi, umtholampilo nalapho ungathola khona usizo. Uhlangana nabanye abafundi ababili bonyaka wokuqala.

text.en: Orientation week: campus tours, res events, a faculty welcome and a party every night. Seniors say this is where most first friends are made.
text.zu: Isonto lokwethulwa: uhambo lwekhampasi, imicimbi ye-res, ukwamukelwa kwefakhalthi nephathi njalo ebusuku. Abafundi abadala bathi yilapho kwakheka khona abangane abaningi bokuqala.

outcome.en: You're exhausted and a little broke, but you know people in every queue now.
outcome.zu: Ukhathele futhi imali iyashoda kancane, kodwa manje wazi abantu kuwo wonke umugqa.

outcome.en: You pick the campus tour and your faculty welcome. You leave with two numbers and a map in your head.
outcome.zu: Ukhetha uhambo lwekhampasi nokwamukelwa kwefakhalthi yakho. Uhamba nezinombolo ezimbili nebalazwe ekhanda.

tip.en: You don't need every event. The campus tour and your faculty welcome matter most.
tip.zu: Awudingi yonke imicimbi. Uhambo lwekhampasi nokwamukelwa kwefakhalthi yikho okubaluleke kakhulu.

outcome.en: You save money and energy. On Monday, everyone else seems to know each other.
outcome.zu: Wonga imali namandla. NgoMsombuluko, bonke abanye babonakala bazana.

text.en: Orientation week: campus tours, a faculty welcome and a party every night. Most first-years are 18. There is also a welcome for mature and part-time students on Tuesday afternoon.
text.zu: Isonto lokwamukela: ukuvakashela ikhampasi, ukwamukelwa yifakhalthi nephathi njalo ebusuku. Iningi labafundi bonyaka wokuqala lineminyaka engu-18. Kukhona nokwamukelwa kwabafundi abadala nabafunda isikhashana ngoLwesibili ntambama.

title.en: Arranging care for someone at home

text.en: You look after someone at home, and your timetable has early lectures four days a week.
text.zu: Unakekela othile ekhaya, futhi uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo lunezifundo zasekuseni izinsuku ezine ngesonto.

label.en: Do it all and commute daily
label.zu: Kwenze konke bese ugibela nsuku zonke

outcome.en: You manage, but you're up at 4:30 every day.
outcome.zu: Uyakwazi, kodwa uvuka ngo-4:30 nsuku zonke.

outcome.en: A relative takes over three mornings a week. You'll owe them a favour, and that's okay.
outcome.zu: Isihlobo sithatha izikhathi zasekuseni ezintathu ngesonto. Uzobakweleta umusa, futhi lokho kulungile.

outcome.en: An advisor helps you choose class groups that fit around your mornings.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki ukusiza ukhethe amaqembu ezifundo ahambisana nezikhathi zakho zasekuseni.

title.en: None of your friends came here

text.en: Your school friends went to other universities or started working. Everyone here seems to know someone already.
text.zu: Abangane bakho besikole baya kwamanye amanyuvesi noma baqala ukusebenza. Wonke umuntu lapha ubonakala esazi othile.

events.research: Understanding Students Issue 1: about a third arrive knowing nobody

outcome.en: It's quieter, but the weekend feels long.
outcome.zu: Kuthule kakhulu, kodwa impelasonto izwakala inde.

outcome.en: At the welcome session, the person next to you is also new and also nervous. You walk to the next event together.
outcome.zu: Eseshinini yokwamukela, umuntu oseduze kwakho naye musha futhi naye uyesaba. Nihamba ndawonye niye emcimbini olandelayo.

outcome.en: The person in the room next to yours is also new and also nervous. You walk to the welcome event together.
outcome.zu: Umuntu osekamelweni eliseduze kwelakho naye musha futhi naye uyesaba. Nihamba ndawonye niye emcimbini wokwamukela.

outcome.en: The games are a bit silly, which helps. You leave with a group chat of ten people.
outcome.zu: Imidlalo iyahlekisa kancane, okusizayo. Uhamba neqembu lokuxoxa labantu abayishumi.

text.en: Most first-years arrived straight from school, some in groups. You're older, and you don't know anyone yet.
text.zu: Iningi labafundi bonyaka wokuqala lifike liqhamuka esikoleni, abanye ngamaqembu. Wena umdala, futhi awukamazi muntu okwamanje.

text.en: You're on your own now. Supper is up to you.

outcome.en: Slightly burnt, completely yours.
outcome.zu: Kushe kancane, kodwa ngokwakho ngokuphelele.

outcome.en: Third night in a row. Your wallet has noticed.
outcome.zu: Ubusuku besithathu bulandelana. Isikhwama sakho sesibonile.

text.en: Nobody is going to wake you tomorrow. The first session is at 8am.
text.zu: Akekho ozokuvusa kusasa. Iseshini yokuqala ingo-8 ekuseni.

outcome.en: You're early, with time for tea.
outcome.zu: Ufika kusenesikhathi, unesikhathi setiye.

outcome.en: You wake at 9:40. The session started at 8.
outcome.zu: Uvuka ngo-9:40. Iseshini iqale ngo-8.

text.en: No bells, no teacher checking. Your week is a blank page.
text.zu: Azikho izinsimbi, akekho uthisha ohlolayo. Isonto lakho liyikhasi elingenalutho.

outcome.en: Lectures, meals, laundry, rest. It fits on one page.
outcome.zu: Izifundo, ukudla, ukuwasha, ukuphumula. Kungena ekhasini elilodwa.

outcome.en: By Thursday you're not sure where the week went.
outcome.zu: NgoLwesine awusazi ukuthi isonto liye kuphi.

text.en: The student card queue is two hours long, and you need the card for the library and the labs.
text.zu: Umugqa wamakhadi abafundi uthatha amahora amabili, futhi udinga ikhadi lomtapo namagumbi amakhompyutha.

outcome.en: Two hours, one new friend, and a card photo you'll regret for years.
outcome.zu: Amahora amabili, umngane oyedwa omusha, nesithombe sekhadi ozozisola ngaso iminyaka.

outcome.en: Twenty minutes. Bring your ID and proof of registration, or you queue twice.
outcome.zu: Imizuzu engamashumi amabili. Letha umazisi wakho nobufakazi bokubhalisa, kungenjalo uma emgqeni kabili.
